source: FallSafe Home Scan prototype (github.com/aaron-chen-angus/fallsafe-home-scan): four HDB room photographs with hazard markers placed by the project team.
notes: Photos load from local_base first (copy the prototype's images/ folder into assets/training/ for offline use), then from remote_base. Annotations are reference labels (x, y = marker centre in % of the photo). cls maps each prototype hazard onto config/vocabulary.json. on_floor / in_walkway restate the prototype descriptions. risk = the prototype's own rating, kept for agreement analysis. Each photo is assigned to one required shot; the bedroom photo goes to the bed-to-door path shot because hazards b1 and b2 are described as lying on the night-time path.
